data.one_liner: Modified linear and circular progress indicators with customizable corner radius and stroke cap.
data.what_it_does: Provides LinearCappedProgressIndicator and CircularCappedProgressIndicator widgets which mirror Flutter's standard progress indicators while adding options to customize corner radius and stroke cap shapes.
use_when: You need standard linear or circular progress indicators with rounded or square ends.
You want a drop-in replacement for Flutter's built-in progress indicators with visual styling adjustments.
avoid_when: You are already satisfied with the default Flutter progress indicators.
You need complex animated chart graphs or loaders beyond basic linear and circular indicators.
strengths: Allows changing corner radius on linear progress indicators.
Allows changing stroke cap on circular progress indicators.
Works identically to standard Flutter progress indicators.
weaknesses: Limited to two specific progress indicator widgets.
Essentially a modified copy of Flutter's internal progress indicator code.
data.setup_notes: Simply add the package to pubspec.yaml and import it.
